rebuild_attempt.planned: Rebuild >=1500 tiles via build_usgs_feature_dataset + build_feature_stack with 20 km absence buffer and spectral repair
rebuild_attempt.blocker: Spectral channels require Google Earth Engine Sentinel composites (feature_engineering.get_sentinel_composite). Prior production qualification documented GEE IAM / spectral INIT failures. Rebuilding 1500 full stacks needs working GEE + OpenTopography at free-tier scale and hours of wall time; this task forbids paid services and must not force a non-protocol corpus.
rebuild_attempt.terrain_only_alternative: A terrain-only stack builder under poc/ could be written, but is a new pipeline not yet validated; not executed in this cycle to avoid inventing an unverified feature contract mid-protocol.
rebuild_attempt.decision: Do not fabricate spectral bands; do not silently train on 240 while claiming protocol minima met.
